tagline: Work items, repos, pipelines, and wikis for remote teammates — writes and runs need your approval.
requirements: Set PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the host environment, scoped to the shared organization and read-only areas, and provide the organization name as the builder input. The launch pins --authentication pat; the local server registers many more tools than documented here.

tools.name: work
tools.note: Lists iterations and reads team settings and capacity (action-based).

tools.name: wit_work_item
tools.note: Reads work items, comments, and revisions (action-based).

tools.name: wit_query
tools.note: Runs saved and ad-hoc WIQL queries.

tools.name: wiki
tools.note: Lists wikis and reads page content.

tools.name: repo_pull_request_org
tools.note: Lists your active pull requests organization-wide.

tools.name: repo_file
tools.note: Reads file contents and directory listings (action-based).

tools.name: pipelines_build
tools.note: Lists builds and reads status and changes (action-based).

tools.name: wit_backlog
tools.note: Lists backlog levels and items, but its reorder action can reorder work items.

tools.name: wit_work_item_comment_write
tools.note: Posts work item comments as your identity.

tools.name: wit_work_item_link_write
tools.note: Links work items, artifacts, and pull requests.

tools.name: repo_file_write
tools.note: Commits file changes to a branch.

tools.name: repo_pull_request_write
tools.note: Creates and updates pull requests, including votes and reviewers.

tools.name: pipelines_write
tools.note: Queues pipeline runs and edits pipeline definitions.

seo.description: Share the official Azure DevOps MCP server with MCPWire. Configure a scoped PAT on the host, let teammates read work items, repos, and pipelines over P2P, and keep writes behind approval.
